    BO13a Lemma 8 and §2.2.5 in other positions of the crown #

    The reversed crown C.rev (same category) turns long ρ-entries into long σ-entries.

    • RayCat.Crown.rev_f_of: C.rev.f t = C.f q when t + q ≡ 1.
    • MulBasis.lemma8_mk, MulBasis.lemma8_rho: Lemma 8 for a long ρ (t+2) (its neighbour σ (t+1)).
    • MulBasis.s225_perm_mk, MulBasis.s225_perm_rho: contours of long ρ-entries are reflecting.
    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.Crown.rev_f_of {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] (C : Crown P) (t q m : ℕ) (h : t + q = 2 * C.n * m + 1) :
    C.rev.f t = C.f q

    Positions t of C.rev and q of C with t + q ≡ 1 carry the same entry.
